description: Translates one message, named by id, into target_language (a language tag such as es or pt-BR) and returns the text with the language it was written in. The first translation into a language is made by an AI model and stored; asking again for the same language reads it back. Nothing is sent to the customer. The translated text comes from what a person outside this business wrote and comes back marked untrusted.

id.description: The id in the resource path.

name: translate_message
title: Translate a message
